facts.text: All enrolled U.S. citizens and permanent residents at Webb Institute receive a full-tuition scholarship covering 100% of tuition costs for their four-year engineering program.

sources.title: Tuition & Fees | Webb Institute
sources.quote: Webb Institute provides all US students and permanent residents who enroll at Webb with a full-tuition scholarship. This scholarship is valued at over $250,000 per student over the four years.
